This is a meat sale contract between Alice (Seller) and Bob (Buyer).

Alice agrees to deliver 100 kg of prime quality meat to Bob's warehouse within 30 days of the contract effective date.

Bob agrees to pay $500 USD within 15 days of delivery.

If Bob fails to pay on time, Bob must additionally pay a late fee of $550 USD (reflecting 10% interest on the original amount).

If Bob fails to pay, Alice may suspend the delivery obligation.

If Bob pays the late fee while delivery is suspended, Bob may request resumption of delivery.

If Alice fails to deliver, Bob may terminate the contract.
